publication: [Magnus, Button, Trueman and Zach, *forall x: Calgary*](https://forallx.openlogicproject.org/forallxyyc.pdf). Cover Fall 2025; served revision `c5cb415`, 2026-09-27; 437 pages. Printed p. + 10 = PDF p.

reviews.checked_passages: Logic planning: validity 2–10; truth tables 80–82; natural-deduction introduction 113–114; soundness chapter 48, 390–397. Opening propositional-entry check: §§6.1–6.3, 49–55; chapters 9–10, 69–73; §§11.1–11.3 and adjacent exercises, 77–84; §§12.1–12.6 and adjacent exercises, 85–92. Used portions are 49–54, 69–71, 77–81, 85–90 and 92. Further planning 2026-10-12: chapters 45–46, 369–380, actual normal-form and positive functional-completeness arguments; NAND/NOR constructions on 378–379. The exclusive binary-connective classification is stated without proof.
reviews.outcome: No serious defect found in this limited scope. Several source soundness rule cases are exercises; the corpus supplies its fixed calculus's full proof. No defect found in the adopted passages; locality, simultaneous substitution, and the finite-row test are proved explicitly. Positive normal-form arguments are usable; atomless formulas and constants need adaptation. In particular implication with the corpus falsity constant expresses negation, so the source's implication-only failure example cannot be transferred unchanged.
